name: J. W. Gallup
bio: J. W. Gallup was a Cave Hills ranchman who in March 1885 came to Medora to get his papers as postmaster at Cave Hills, and in April reported cattle losses in the Cave Hills a little above average, heaviest for the Hashknife outfit. By February 1886 Aleck Connell had bought out his Cave Hills ranch.
